summary: Competition check 2026-10-09 for AS02: 43 market actors recorded (6 competitors, 9 alternatives); details list what each does, its traction signal, licence and the gap versus the candidate. Source files: R3-specialists.md under docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/research/.
details:
- Distil Labs [competitor]: Agent trace distillation into hosted/downloadable 135M-9B students using open-weight teachers Gap/note: upper rungs only; user picks task; no fallback/retirement Traction: ~12 staff, investor Project A; launch 2026-07-08 (https://tracxn.com/d/companies/distil-labs/__pjQP3-rT28mIslUKv2nLjQk17f21sXGvK3FX-1izixA). Licence: proprietary; weights under R&D licence. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Pioneer (Fastino) [competitor]: Agentic fine-tuning and adaptive retraining of open small models from production verdicts Gap/note: task-description driven; no discovery or fallback Traction: Fastino $17.5M seed (May 2025) (https://finder.techleap.nl/news/feed/fastino-raises-17-5m-for-ai-models). Licence: proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Inference.net Catalyst [competitor]: Gateway capture to datasets/evals to task-specific models with continuous retraining Gap/note: no opportunity detection; silent on provider terms Traction: $11.8M seed Oct 2025 (https://finder.techleap.nl/news/feed/inference-net-raises-11-8m-seed-funding). Licence: proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Overmind [competitor]: Repo capability scan, trace-to-dataset, prompt experiments and fine-tunes with backtests Gap/note: capability map from code, no escalation rule Traction: 605 GitHub stars (https://github.com/overmind-core/overmind). Licence: AGPL-3.0 platform, MIT SDK. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Amazon Bedrock Model Distillation [alternative]: Teacher-student distillation from prompts or invocation logs Gap/note: cloud-locked, no local fallback Traction: AWS service (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-distillation.html). Licence: commercial. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Applied Compute [alternative]: RL-trained custom enterprise models/agents, services model Gap/note: high-touch services version of specialization Traction: $80M at $1.3B post (Apr 2026) (https://www.lw.com/en/news/2026/04/latham-represents-applied-compute-in-fundraise). Licence: proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- TensorZero [benchmark]: LLMOps gateway with feedback, SFT, GEPA, A/B; archived Gap/note: closest flywheel; wound down Traction: 11.7k stars; archived 2026-06-12 (https://github.com/tensorzero/tensorzero). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenPipe (hosted platform) [benchmark]: SFT-from-logs platform acquired by CoreWeave; legacy platform retired 2026-07-30 Gap/note: consolidated into GPU cloud Traction: acquisition announced 2025-09-03 (https://www.coreweave.com/news/coreweave-to-acquire-openpipe-leader-in-reinforcement-learning). Licence: proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenPipe ART + RULER [partner]: GRPO agent RL harness with LLM-judge relative rewards Gap/note: RL rung backend Traction: 10.8k stars (https://github.com/OpenPipe/ART). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Microsoft Agent Lightning [partner]: Gateway + rollout controller + verl trainer for harnessed agent RL Gap/note: RL rung backend; no when/what-to-train logic Traction: 18.6k stars; self-reported SWE-bench Verified 41.8->56.4% (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-lightning). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenAI fine-tuning / RFT [benchmark]: Self-serve fine-tuning wind-down; no new jobs after 2027-01-06 Gap/note: provider signal of declining fine-tuning need Traction: deprecation notice (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations). Licence: commercial. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Fireworks RFT / Training API [partner]: Remote-environment RL fine-tuning; managed RFT deprecated Gap/note: hosted training backend Traction: docs (https://docs.fireworks.ai/fine-tuning/environments). Licence: commercial. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Thinking Machines Tinker [partner]: LoRA fine-tuning API Gap/note: training backend Traction: GA 2025-12-12 (https://siliconangle.com/2025/12/12/thinking-machines-makes-tinker-ai-fine-tuning-service-generally-available/). Licence: commercial. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Prime Intellect Lab [partner]: Environments Hub, verifiers, hosted agentic RL Gap/note: environment rewards Traction: public beta (https://docs.primeintellect.ai/hosted-training/what-is-lab). Licence: open-source verifiers; hosted service. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Adaptive ML [competitor]: Enterprise RL fine-tuning, judge evals, A/B and feedback loop Gap/note: enterprise RLOps without discovery Traction: $20M seed 2024 (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240312461522/en). Licence: proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Predibase (Rubrik) [benchmark]: LoRA/RFT platform absorbed into Rubrik Agent Cloud Gap/note: exit by acquisition Traction: acquired 2025 (https://techcrunch.com/2025/06/25/rubrik-acquires-predibase-to-accelerate-adoption-of-ai-agents/). Licence: proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Anyscale post-training skill [partner]: Agent skill choosing SFT/DPO/RLVR method and generating configs Gap/note: method selection, not whether to fine-tune Traction: launched 2026-05-14 (https://anyscale.com/blog/anyscale-llm-post-training-skill). Licence: commercial platform. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Together AI fine-tuning [partner]: SFT/DPO LoRA or full fine-tuning with downloadable weights Gap/note: training backend Traction: docs (https://docs.together.ai/docs/fine-tuning-overview). Licence: commercial. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Unsloth [partner]: Local efficient LoRA/QLoRA/GRPO training Gap/note: local training rung Traction: 77.6k stars (https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth). Licence: Apache-2.0 core; AGPL-3.0 Studio. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Axolotl [partner]: Config-driven SFT/DPO/GRPO fine-tuning Gap/note: local training rung Traction: active 2026 releases (https://docs.axolotl.ai/). Licence: Apache-2.0 (third-party listing). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Oumi [partner]: Open training/evaluation platform Gap/note: training backend Traction: $10M seed Jan 2025 (https://www.geekwire.com/2025/ex-google-apple-engineers-raise-10m-to-give-ai-its-linux-moment-with-new-open-source-platform/). Licence: open source. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Kiln [alternative]: Desktop workbench for evals, synthetic data, fine-tuning, auto-optimize Gap/note: manual task-first Traction: 5.2k stars (https://github.com/Kiln-AI/Kiln). Licence: MIT library; source-available app. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Arcee AI [benchmark]: Pivoted from post-training services to own open-weight Trinity models Gap/note: customization business pivot Traction: Series B >$1B valuation 2026-09-16 (https://thenextweb.com/news/arcee-ai-series-b-1bn-valuation-open-weight-trinity). Licence: open-weight models (licence per model). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Lamini [benchmark]: Enterprise fine-tuning; team transitioned to AMD Gap/note: exit Traction: ~$25M raised before transition (https://aicouncil.com/profile/sharon-zhou). Licence: proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- DatologyAI [benchmark]: Training-data curation Gap/note: adjacent, not trace-based Traction: $46M Series A 2024 (https://blog.datologyai.com/datologyai-raises-46m-series-a). Licence: proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- SkillOpt / SkillOpt-Sleep [competitor]: Held-out-gated skill optimization; nightly mining of recurring tasks from coding-agent transcripts Gap/note: covers discovery+skills rung; no weights/fallback/retirement Traction: 18.2k stars (https://github.com/microsoft/SkillOpt). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Hermes Agent [alternative]: Self-improving agent creating skills from experience; trajectory generation Gap/note: skills rung without eval gate Traction: 252k stars (https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- DSPy [partner]: Programmatic LM pipelines with GEPA/MIPROv2/BootstrapFinetune/GRPO optimizers Gap/note: ladder components Traction: 38.6k stars (https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- GEPA [partner]: Reflective Pareto optimizer for text artifacts Gap/note: prompt/skill rung Traction: 6.9k stars (https://github.com/gepa-ai/gepa). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Opik Agent Optimizer [partner]: Suite of prompt/agent optimizers on Opik datasets Gap/note: prompt rung Traction: Comet product docs (https://www.comet.com/docs/opik/agent_optimization/algorithms/overview). Licence: open-source SDK. Checked 2026-10-09.
- LangMem [alternative]: Memory extraction and prompt refinement Gap/note: procedural memory without gate Traction: 1.7k stars (https://github.com/langchain-ai/langmem). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Letta [alternative]: Stateful agents; user-triggered skill learning Gap/note: skills rung, manual Traction: $10M seed 2024 (https://techcrunch.com/2024/09/23/letta-one-of-uc-berkeleys-most-anticipated-ai-startups-has-just-come-out-of-stealth). Licence: open source. Checked 2026-10-09.
- ACE (Agentic Context Engineering) [benchmark]: Evolving playbook contexts for self-improving agents Gap/note: context rung research Traction: ICLR 2026 paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04618). Licence: open code. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Mem0 [alternative]: Memory layer for agents Gap/note: fact memory, not specialization Traction: $24M; 41k stars (Oct 2025) (https://techcrunch.com/2025/10/28/mem0-raises-24m-from-yc-peak-xv-and-basis-set-to-build-the-memory-layer-for-ai-apps). Licence: open-source core + cloud (licence not verified). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Zep / Graphiti [alternative]: Temporal knowledge-graph agent memory Gap/note: fact memory Traction: reported nearing $1M ARR (search snippet) (https://www.getzep.com/downloads/451Research_Reprint_ZepSoftware_10APR2026.pdf). Licence: open-source Graphiti + cloud. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Microsoft Trace [benchmark]: AutoDiff-like optimization of AI systems with general feedback Gap/note: research optimizer Traction: 763 stars (https://github.com/microsoft/Trace). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- TextGrad [benchmark]: Textual-gradient optimization Gap/note: research optimizer Traction: 3.8k stars (https://github.com/zou-group/textgrad). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- EvoAgentX [benchmark]: Workflow generation and evolution with TextGrad/MIPRO/AFlow Gap/note: wo
